items.title: How green is your robot? And other awkward questions
items.summary: Deborah Lupton / Servers in a Landscape / Licenced by CC-BY 4.0 By Emmet Cole Robots clean rivers and sort waste , monitor ecosystems , and inspect renewable-energy infrastructure . But even the greenest robot has an environmental footprint. If robotics is going to help build a more sustainable world, the robotics community has to answer some potentially awkward questions, starting with this one: How sustainable are robots themselves? Across a full lifecycle, from rare earth mineral extraction and manufacturing to operation and end-of-life, robots have an environmental impact. But the robotics community has, until now, lacked dedicated tools for calculating it.
